title: Stories and History
text: Make sure what’s app is working.  Easy to find meeting place.  Great stories and the few shops were actually of  important historical significance.  Kept it moving and very interesting. Like he said 2000 years of history in one big circle.
author: MarianMcNeil

title: Adi, the guide, was very...
text: Adi, the guide, was very knowledgeable and an excellent guide.  This tour will reveal some truly hidden parts of Barcelona that are very interesting and that you would never notice on your own.
author: Barbara_M

title: Wonderful tour of Barcelona
text: Our tour guide Ida gave us a wonderful tour of many highlights of Barcelona. He covered the historic sights with detailed and interesting insight. We walked for 2 hours and saw a large number of very different landmarks.  He was respectful of others and ensured to keep at the pace with which we felt comfortable. Ida definitely knew the history of Barcelona and how it meshed with the world. Don’t miss this tour.
author: Samuel_K

title: Adi had great information...
text: Adi had great information and lots of hidden little spots to explore. Very friendly and easy to chat with. Had a great time!
author: Ben_R

title: Best way to get to know Barcelona
text: Adi was a wonderful guide. He’s intelligent, funny, and makes the experience memorable. It was only my wife and I so the experience was perfectly catered to us and we could ask all our questions. We had so much fun! In a small group we could go to places the large groups could not. So memorable!
author: Abhayjeet_S

title: Off the beaten path
text: Adi was very knowledgeable about the area.  He had a nice way of presenting the stories he told us.  He didn't rush.   We stopped in several stores to see places that have been there for many years.  For example the pharmacy.  The stories included the little tidbits of facts or gossip you like to hear.  This was a good change from the more common things you see.
author: Linda_P

title: Amazing tour
text:
What a great tour ,full of hidden facinating  places you can never find by yourself and interesting stories ,our guide Adi was very knowledgaeble but with a great sense of humor as well
I really recommend this tour.
author: Paola_J
